line_items.reasoning: Q1 actual revenue of $14.9B exceeded prior guidance of ~$14.6B by ~$300M (~2%), with YoY growth of 25% surpassing the guided 22%.
Adjusted EBITDA came in at a record 68% of revenue, meaningfully above the guided ~66%, and infrastructure software gross/operating margins expanded well beyond expectations.

AI revenue of $4.1B beat the guided ~$3.8B by ~8% (77% YoY vs. guided 65%), driven by stronger-than-expected hyperscaler networking shipments; infrastructure software ABV also exceeded the guided >$3B threshold.

No material deviations were reported on the non-GAAP tax rate, diluted share count, or dividend — all appear consistent with prior guidance, though free cash flow was pressured by debt and tax headwinds not explicitly guided against.
